item.title: Check It Out: Voice Actor Jamie Sara Lewis
item.description: In this week’s edition of Check It Out, Tom and Maggie sit down with someone you may not have seen, but you have heard on TV, in movies and even in some video games. We welcome voice actor Jamie Sara Lewis to the podcast, and she lets us know about her work on the Netflix show “Dr. Seuss’s The Sneetches” an upcoming movie this summer and her some programs for youngsters interested in acting and voicework. Join us this week for a very animated Check It Out.

item.title: CNY Heroes, Episode 40 – How Tops Friendly Markets Supports Veterans
item.description: On this edition of CNY Heroes, Dan speaks with Kathy Allen, the recently retired Senior Manager of Community Relations at Tops Friendly Markets. Kathy flew as a guardian on Honor Flight Syracuse Mission 4 in 2014, sparking a longtime partnership between Tops and Honor Flight. Under her leadership, Tops has been a leading supporter of the organization, generously donating the backpacks full of snacks and other goodies that veterans and guardians receive on mission day. item.title: Feb. 5, 2026: Christopher Costanza at CMSU
item.description: Utica native Christopher Costanza, cello, is coming to the Chamber Music Society of Utica to perform this weekend, along with pianist Anne-Marie McDermott. Chris spoke to host Diane Jones about the concert, his years of performing with Anne-Marie, and his opportunity to study the “Quartet for the End of Time” with composer Olivier Messiaen. More about the Chamber Music Society of Utica is available here. And more about Christopher Costanza is available on his website.
